summary_1line: The creature secretly observes the De Lacey family, learns their words and kindness, helps them anonymously, and becomes painfully aware of his own deformity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hidden beside the cottage, the creature watches the blind old father smiling while Felix and Agatha gently serve him food.
At night the creature secretly piles freshly cut firewood outside the cottage door while the family sleeps.
The creature recoils in horror at his reflection in a clear forest pool, realizing his own monstrous appearance.
